bridal-juttis.title: Bridal Juttis | Gulbhahar's Limited‑Edition Bridal/ Wedding Juttis | Only 24 Pairs per Design
bridal-juttis.description: Step into your wedding day in luxury. Gulbhahar's limited‑edition bridal jutis are handcrafted and released in only 24 pairs per design. Each pair features elegant detailing, free custom embroidery and comes in a numbered collector's box.

juttis.title: Traditional Juttis | Handcrafted Footwear Collection | Gulbhahar
juttis.description: Explore our exquisite collection of traditional handcrafted juttis. Each pair is meticulously crafted by skilled artisans using centuries-old techniques for authentic ethnic footwear.

heels.title: Designer Heels | Contemporary Ethnic Heels Collection | Gulbhahar
heels.description: Discover our stunning collection of designer heels that blend traditional craftsmanship with contemporary style. Perfect for weddings, parties, and special occasions.

bags.title: Handcrafted Bags | Traditional Purses & Clutches | Gulbhahar
bags.description: Beautifully handcrafted bags and clutches that complement your traditional attire. Each piece showcases exquisite embroidery and authentic Indian craftsmanship.
